faq.q: What is the weather like in Marbella in April 2031?
faq.a: Expect average highs of 20–22°C and lows around 12°C. Sea temperatures hover at 16°C, so swimming is brisk but possible. Sunshine averages 9 hours per day, with occasional light showers. Winds are typically 10–15 knots from the east, making mornings the calmest time for cruising.

faq.q: Is it warm enough for a yacht charter in April?
faq.a: Yes – daytime temperatures of 17–22°C are comfortable for cruising. Bring a light jacket for sea breezes. The sun is strong enough for sunbathing on deck, though you'll want a swimsuit only for the brave. Most guests enjoy the scenery, dolphin spotting, and lunch at anchor.

faq.q: When is Easter 2031 and how does it affect availability?
faq.a: Easter Sunday 2031 falls on 6 April. This is a peak period for Marbella yacht charters, especially in Puerto Banús. We recommend booking by late February to secure your preferred boat. Easter week (30 March – 6 April) sees higher demand but still better availability than July or August.

faq.q: Which boats are available for an April charter?
faq.a: Our entire fleet operates year-round. Popular choices for April include the Azimut 39 (€749/2h, 11 pax) for smaller groups, and the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h, 12 pax) which includes a free jet ski. Larger vessels like the Ferretti 94 (29m) and Canados 86 are also available – pricing on request.

faq.q: What are the sea conditions like in April?
faq.a: The Mediterranean is generally calm in April. Swell averages 0.5–1.5m, with occasional days of 2m+ if a Levante wind blows. Our skippers monitor forecasts and adjust itineraries accordingly. Mornings are usually glassy, making for smooth sailing along the coast from Puerto Banús to Cabopino or Estepona.

faq.q: Can we swim or use water toys in April?
faq.a: Swimming is possible but the sea is cool (16°C). Some guests enjoy a quick dip; others prefer sunbathing. Our Mangusta 80 charter includes a jet ski. We also have paddleboards and snorkel gear available on request. Water temperatures rise steadily through the month.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs. Just bring sunscreen and a towel. For the Mangusta 80, a jet ski is also included free.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book an Easter charter?
faq.a: For Easter 2031 (6 April), book by late February at the latest. Popular boats like the Azimut 39 and Mangusta 80 fill quickly. If you have a specific vessel in mind, early booking ensures availability. Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing on larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Maiora 26m.

data.body_html:
April 2031 is shaping up to be an ideal month for a Marbella yacht charter, especially around the Easter holidays. With average temperatures of 17°C, 9 hours of daily sunshine, and calm sea conditions, you can enjoy the Costa del Sol without the summer crowds. Whether you're planning a family day out or a group celebration, our fleet in Puerto Banús offers options from €749 for two hours up to luxury superyachts. This guide covers weather averages, Easter availability, and which boat suits your April plans. For an overview of all options, see our boat rental Marbella hub.

April 2031 Weather in Marbella: What to Expect

April in Marbella is spring at its best. Daytime highs reach 20–22°C, with overnight lows around 12°C. Sea temperature sits at 16°C – brisk but swimmable on sunny afternoons. Wind patterns are typically easterly at 10–15 knots, with calmer mornings. Rainfall averages 35mm across the month, usually as short showers. For a Marbella yacht charter, the best windows are 10:00–16:00 when the sun is highest. The Levante wind can occasionally pick up, but our skippers know the sheltered coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés.

Easter 2031 Dates and Booking Tips

Easter Sunday 2031 falls on 6 April. This means the holiday period runs from Palm Sunday (30 March) through Easter Monday (7 April). Demand for yacht charters in Marbella spikes during this week, especially for boats departing from Puerto Banús. We recommend booking by late February to secure your preferred vessel. Popular choices like the Azimut 39 (€749/2h) and Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h with jet ski) are often reserved first. For larger groups, the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m) offer luxury – pricing available on request via WhatsApp.

All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. For smaller groups, the Azimut 39 is a great value option.

Where to Cruise in April: Recommended Itineraries

April's mild weather makes for comfortable cruising along the Costa del Sol. Popular routes from Puerto Banús include:

  • West to Estepona (approx. 10 NM) – stop for lunch in the marina or anchor at Playa del Cristo.
  • East to Cabopino (8 NM) – quieter beaches and the Artola Dunes nature reserve.
  • South to Cala del Faro (5 NM) – a sheltered cove with clear water, ideal for anchoring.

Whale and dolphin sightings are common in spring. Bring binoculars for the best views of the Sierra Blanca and La Concha mountain backdrop.

What to Wear and Pack for an April Yacht Charter

Layers are key. A light jacket or fleece for the morning breeze, plus a t-shirt for midday sun. Sunscreen (SPF 30+) is essential even on cloudy days – UV levels are moderate to high. Sunglasses, a hat, and non-slip shoes are recommended. If you plan to swim, a wetsuit or rash vest helps with the 16°C sea temperature. Our charters provide towels, but bring your own if you prefer.

Easter Events and Activities in Marbella

Marbella and nearby towns host processions and events during Semana Santa. Puerto Banús has a lively atmosphere, with restaurants and bars open late. If you're chartering over Easter weekend, consider a sunset cruise to watch the processions from the water. For a full-day charter, combine a morning sail with an afternoon visit to Marbella's Old Town or the Golden Mile. Check local listings for 2031 events closer to the date.
